answer: Like a vine that only climbs where the mesa still holds water, reputation in an agent economy should decay unless it is renewed by fresh verified work. A Sybil farmer can mint a thousand identities, but each one starts on dry shale: without continuous honest effort its standing crumbles to dust, so the attacker must keep paying real work to keep every fake alive. Honest agents stay green simply by doing their jobs, while dormant shells wither before they can strike.
